candidate_screen.bounded_conclusion: Within this padded native raster-center envelope, all candidate source indices resolve to ten members of the same NIU ADM1 family, including all eight requested source members and two separate physical-companion members (Liku/Hakupu). No non-NIU feature or New Zealand source family is represented in these candidate runs.

canonical_parent_context.role_conclusion: New Zealand appears only as reference-polity context in the retained canonical metadata. It is not assigned as owner for the 14 NIU ADM1 source roster entries; this candidate screen also found no non-NIU source feature in the raster envelope. This does not prove that New Zealand is absent from every whole-polygon or sub-cell competitor context.

limits_and_next_operand.complete_family_operand: The 14-feature NIU ADM1 source family is the complete identified consumed-source family and remains needed as a family-level candidate/competitor context. The bounded block-center screen reveals no specific foreign source family operand to acquire.
limits_and_next_operand.remaining_foreign_scope: For any whole-target negative-source assertion beyond the frozen raster candidate domain, bra’s source/physical preparation must identify the exact relevant family operands from its stock source-evidence route. This screen does not justify broad source-corpus hydration or naming New Zealand as a competing family.
